You can only see the tracker on the desktop website.

From the dashboard, click on your account. Then click on the “Account” tab right below the your account name “U.S. Bank Smartly Checking XXXX”. If you scroll down, you’ll see a “New account bonus progress” option on the right under “Services”, right above the T&C.

If you still don’t see it, then there is definitely something up on their end. Also, fwiw, this only works for the personal checking bonus. I’m also doing personal savings, business checking, and business savings at the moment and there isn’t a tracker available for any of them.

I just funded P2’s new U.S. Bank Smartly Checking account with a $275 purchase on her Blue Business Cash Amex. It shows on the U.S. Bank account opening site as a $275 deposit receipt and there is currently a “Pending US Bank” charge on the Amex website, so I think it will post fine.

Bonus Tracker DP: (FWIW)

Smartly Checking account opened in October.I looked everywhere for the bonus tracker. Read everything I could find on DoC about it. I know some people just don’t get it from the DPs.Thinking maybe I didn’t get the promotion applied to my account I called,Representative I spoke with said the tracker would appear, “eventually”.She also confirmed the promo code was applied and I met the requirements for the bonus. I didn’t ask, she just offered that out of the blue.I don’t know what to make of it. US Bank is seriously annoying though. I spent 15 minutes talking to their IVR, going around and around. Finally I had enough and just kept responding “representative” over and over until it finally relented. I will make a note to update this post if the tracker does finally appear on my account, it is still absent as of today.
When I clicked on Learn more it took me to a U.S. Bank Smartly Checking referral website – get $100 for you & a friend! Oh well. I tried. Thanks.

It’s only in the 1st sentence of the terms at the bottom of the page…

Disclosures
﻿

  1. U.S. Bank Smartly® Checking bonus: “To be eligible, you or any owner(s) on your new Bank Smartly Checking account cannot have an existing U.S. Bank consumer checking account, had a U.S. Bank consumer checking account in the last 12 months or received other U.S. Bank consumer checking bonus offers within the past 12 months.”
I just opened a smartly checking account last month and I see the 500 savings offer under “products and offers” –> “next steps” or something like that (mobile Chrome browser).

Looks like $5 monthly fee if you don’t have a Smartly Checking account. Also looks like min of 6 months before you can close (or $25 fee). So probably have to factor in about $30 in fees. Still decent bonus I think.

Target email: “<name>, earn up to $500 + X.XX% Annual Percentage Yield.” (yes, it was X.XX% in the subject)

“Give your money a raise: Up to $500 & 3.50% Annual Percentage Yield (APY)1,2
Open a new U.S. Bank Smartly® Savings account and complete qualifying activities to earn your bonus. Plus, maximize your interest rate by having an additional eligible account and a Combined Qualifying Balance (CQB) of $25,000 or more.”
I do not have a Smartly account and was targeted. I only have had a personal checking in the past.
I wonder if you have to have a Smartly checking account to be targeted. Neither P1 nor P2 currently have a personal checking account and neither of us are targeted.
